For other uses, see [[Sand Seal (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Sand Seal Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Sand Seal Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |era= {{List| * [[Era of Foundation]] * [[Era of the Wilds]] }} |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |attack= |weapon= |cost= |value= |characteristics= |members= {{List| [[Nah]], [[Patricia]], [[Sue]], [[Zarashi]], }} |theme= }} '''Sand Seals''' are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Sand Seal|Sand Seals|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Sand Seal}} Sand Seals are naturally yellowish tan in color and have long tusks similar to a {{Wp|walrus}}. Sand Seals are native to the [[Gerudo Desert Gateway]], but they can be found throughout the [[Gerudo Desert]]. Sand Seals are capable of [[Swimming]] through the [[Sand]] of the Gerudo Desert as if it were [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. [[Link]] can [[Sand-Seal Surfing|Sand-Seal Surf]] by catching a wild Sand Seal, but he must have a [[Shield]] and must approach it very slowly due to its sensitivity to sound. He can also approach them after temporarily stunning them using [[Remote Bomb]]s or [[Bomb Arrow]]s. Sand-Seal Surfing is the quickest way to travel through the Gerudo Desert. The [[Gerudo]] train Sand Seals and rely on them for travel across the Gerudo Desert. Trained Sand Seals are red in color, faster, and will wait for their rider to return instead of running off the moment they are dismounted. Link can rent a Sand Seal at the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Northwest Booth]] or the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth]] in [[Gerudo Town]] for 20 [[Rupee]]s or 50 Rupees if he does not have a Shield. These [[Shop]]s are marked by [[Sand-Seal Statue]]s. [[Riju]]'s blue Sand Seal, [[Patricia]], can be found in the [[Palace Courtyard]] beside the [[Royal Palace]] of Gerudo Town, where she is cared for by [[Padda]]. Patricia is said to be a wise oracle. Padda will translate Patricia's words of wisdom if Link feeds the Seal some [[Fruit]]. Patricia assists Riju in getting near the [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]] while disabling its legs during the [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]" [[Main Quest]]. The Gerudo participate in [[Sand-Seal Race|Sand-Seal Racing]], a traditional Gerudo competition that involves Sand-Seal Surfing races. Link can participate in Sand-Seal Racing at the [[Sand-Seal Rally]] after calming Naboris. To complete "[[The Undefeated Champ]]" [[Shrine Quest]], Link must beat the current record of 1:30, held by the Sand-Seal Racing champion, [[Tali]], in order to obtain the [[Grand Trophy]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Sand Seal}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} One Sand Seal, [[Patricia]], appears in {{AoC}}. She serves as [[Riju]]'s attack method. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== Although Sand Seals do not appear in {{AoI}}, one is featured as the subject of the [[Quest]] "[[Ardi and the Sand Seal]]". During the Quest, [[Ardi]] rescues a Sand Seal that was injured by [[Monster]]s, but it has trouble recovering from its ordeal. With [[Lenalia]]'s help, the Sand Seal's health improves to the point where it can be released back into the [[Gerudo Desert]], though Ardi clears the area of Monsters first. The Best Sand Seal|Game Screen|AoC}} {{Cite|{{Big|Ardi and the Sand Seal}}
{{Color AoI|Teal|Gerudo}}

While in the Gerudo Desert the other day, Lady Ardi rescued a sand seal that was being attacked by monsters. Sadly, the poor thing still hasn't recovered its strength, but I think a bit of nourishment will be just the thing to help it turn the corner.

Once the sand seal was on the mend, Lady Ardi returned it to the desert—but not before clearing the area of monsters so it wouldn't be attacked. I do hope we get to see our new friend again one of these days!
